raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

This PR adds AITER's fused RoPE + KV cache kernels for DeepSeek MLA models on AMD ROCm. Combines RoPE application, KV cache writes, and dual RMSNorm into optimized fusion paths.

### Key Features
- **Fused Dual RMSNorm**: Uses AITER's `fused_qk_rmsnorm` 
- **Fused RoPE + KV Cache (Prefill)**: Single kernel for RoPE and cache write
- **Fused BMM + RoPE + KV Cache (Decode)**: Combines matmul, RoPE, and cache write
- **FP4 and FP8 Support**: Separate optimized kernels for both quantization formats

### AITER Kernels Used
- `fused_qk_rmsnorm` - Dual RMSNorm fusion
- `fused_qk_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` - RoPE + KV cache (prefill)
- `fused_fp4_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` - FP4 BMM + RoPE + KV cache (decode)
- `fused_fp8_bmm_rope_cat_and_cache_mla` - FP8 BMM + RoPE + KV cache (decode)

### Testing

Verified on GSM8K benchmark with DeepSeek-V3:
```bash
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_USE_AITER_FUSED=1
export HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7

lm_eval \
  --model vllm \
  --model_args "pretrained=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3,tensor_parallel_size=8,max_model_len=8192,max_num_batched_tokens=131072,gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,dtype=bfloat16,kv_cache_dtype=fp8,trust_remote_code=true" \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --batch_size auto \
  --limit 500
```

|-------|--------|----------------|--------|-------------|---|------|---|----------|
|gsm8k|      3      |flexible-extract |     5.      |exact_match|↑  |0.934|±    |0.0111|
|            |              |strict-match     |     5.       |exact_match|↑  |0.934|±    |0.0111|


### Performance

***Output Token Throughput (tok/s)***

| RMSNorm + KV Cache     |   940.59 |  2136.05 |  3519.24 |  4130.67 |  4641.81 |  4936.77 |

***Total Token Throughput (tok/s)***

| Version                |    1 RPS |    3 RPS |   10 RPS |   20 RPS |   50 RPS |  inf RPS |
|------------------------|----------|----------|----------|----------|----------|----------|
| vLLM Main              |  1888.29 |  4345.67 |  7149.73 |  8321.32 |  9326.57 |  9893.88 |
| RMSNorm + KV Cache     |  1881.17 |  4272.10 |  7038.48 |  8261.34 |  9283.62 |  9831.51 |

***Time to First Token - Mean (ms)***

| Version                |  1 RPS |  3 RPS | 10 RPS | 20 RPS | 50 RPS | inf RPS |

| vLLM Main              | 164.72 | 137.51 | 177.05 | 224.57 | 281.14 | 1440.02 |
| RMSNorm + KV Cache     | 212.67 | 204.29 | 254.68 | 273.77 | 346.60 | 1448.46 |

***Time Per Output Token - Mean (ms)***

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces fused kernels for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) on ROCm platforms using the AITER library, specifically adding fused dual RMSNorm and fused RoPE with KV cache operations for both prefill and decode phases. The implementation includes new custom ops, environment variable controls, and logic within the MLA attention layers to utilize these optimizations when available. Review feedback identifies several unintentional changes to global configuration defaults—specifically reverting the default for CUDA graph memory estimation and modifying video loader documentation—which should be reverted to maintain consistency with existing vLLM behavior.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The default value for `VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS` has been changed from `True` to `False`. This is a global configuration that affects memory profiling accuracy for CUDA graphs across all platforms. This change reverts a default established in v0.21.0 and appears unrelated to the ROCm AITER MLA implementation. If this was unintentional, it should be reverted to avoid regressions in memory estimation for NVIDIA users.

```suggestion
    VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: bool = True
```

+def _rocm_aiter_mla_dual_rmsnorm_impl(
+    q_c: torch.Tensor,
+    q_a_layernorm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    q_a_layernorm_variance_epsilon: float,
+    kv_c: torch.Tensor,

+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Fused dual RMSNorm for MLA using aiter's fused_qk_rmsnorm.
+
+    Fuses RMSNorm on q_c and kv_c into a single kernel call. Returns BF16
+    outputs, ~2× faster than separate RMS norms.
+
+    Uses aiter.ops.fused_qk_norm_rope_cache_quant.fused_qk_rmsnorm which is
+    optimized for dual RMS norm with 2D grid parallelization and automatic
+    fallback to separate norms for very large batch sizes (≥16384 tokens).
+
+    Returns:
+        (q_c_normed, kv_c_normed): Both BF16 tensors after RMSNorm
+    """
+    from aiter.ops.fused_qk_norm_rope_cache_quant import fused_qk_rmsnorm
+
+    q_c_normed, kv_c_normed = fused_qk_rmsnorm(
+        q_c,
+        q_a_layernorm_weight,
+        q_a_layernorm_variance_epsilon,
+        kv_c,
+        kv_a_layernorm_weight,
+        kv_a_layernorm_variance_epsilon,
+    )
+    return q_c_normed, kv_c_normed
+
+
+def _rocm_aiter_mla_dual_rmsnorm_fake(
+    q_c: torch.Tensor,
+    q_a_layernorm_weight: torch.Tensor,

+    """Fake implementation for torch.compile/CUDA graphs.

+    out2_normed = torch.empty_like(kv_c)  # BF16 kv_c after RMSNorm
+    return out1_normed, out2_normed

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The default value for `VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS` has been changed from `True` to `False`. This is a global configuration that affects memory profiling accuracy for CUDA graphs across all platforms. This change reverts a default established in v0.21.0 and appears unrelated to the ROCm AITER MLA implementation. If this was unintentional, it should be reverted to avoid regressions in memory estimation for NVIDIA users.

```suggestion
    VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: bool = True
```

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces fused kernels for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) on ROCm platforms using the AITER library, specifically adding fused dual RMSNorm and fused RoPE with KV cache operations for both prefill and decode phases. The implementation includes new custom ops, environment variable controls, and logic within the MLA attention layers to utilize these optimizations when available. Review feedback identifies several unintentional changes to global configuration defaults—specifically reverting the default for CUDA graph memory estimation and modifying video loader documentation—which should be reverted to maintain consistency with existing vLLM behavior.
